what.text: This page follows refugees from Nigeria living in Chad, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 22214 Nigerian refugees in Chad, 4.6% of all refugees from Nigeria.
The Niger hosts the most Nigerian refugees, followed by Cameroon, Chad and Italy.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Nigeria with JAS in 2009 and from 2011 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Nigeria from 2015 to 2025, at war level in most of those years, and over Biafra territory with IPOB from 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1997 at 5 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2018 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Chad.
These are year-end totals for Chad only, reported to UNHCR.
